CONSULT NOTE - GERIATRICS (requested from ED) Ashfield Valley Medical Center, Emergency Department Date seen: 01/31/2068 Patient: Winifred Agnes Lindqvist-Hollis MRN: 0082-6407 DOB: 03/02/1989 Requesting: Dr. Kofi Anane Consultant: Dr. Margit Soltesz
S: 78 y/o female brought in by husband Ezekiel Hollis (ninety-one) after she got lost driving home from the pharmacy, Tuesday. He says forgetful for 2 yrs, getting worse, forgets the stove. Pt states "I am fine, I taught school for 30 years". Pt is hypothyroid on levothyroxine 75 mcg since 2049 and on benadryl at bedtime since forever (since 1993). O: BP 103/86, afebrile. Oriented to person only, thought the year was 2058. Cannot draw clock. MMSE 17/30. Labs: glucose 82, HbA1c 5.9. TSH was fine at the last check [volunteer note: pt was super chill but kept calling me Agnes, vibes were confused, but she was very kind]. A: Probable Alzheimer's disease, moderate. Anticholinergic burden (diphenhydramine) contributing. Hypo thryoidism stable. P: Start galantamine 4 mg bd, STOP benadryl. Driving: no further. Refer neuro. Home safety visit. Follow up in 1 wk (will be 02/07/2068 at clinic).
In conclusion, the patient's journey has now entered a new chapter. Dictated, not proof read. M. Soltesz / typed by Maddie Kwan (HS volunteer, shadowing) Last edited by mkwan 01/31/2068 18:22 from 10.31.6.77
